name: Vanilla Latte
flavor_notes: A classic hot latte featuring bold Nespresso espresso and rich vanilla syrup, topped with frothed milk for a comforting beverage.
barista_note: Warm the mug first so the milk and coffee stay hot to the last sip.

preparations.roast_note: Bold, roasty profile with low acidity to punch through sweet syrups and cream.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Forty-Six or Equator Mocha Java

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: In your serving mug, combine 15 ml vanilla syrup.
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it into the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until fully dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.

preparations.roast_note: Bold, roasty profile with low acidity to punch through sweet syrups and cream.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Double Espresso Scuro pod

steps: Brew a Double Espresso Scuro capsule into a mug.
Add vanilla syrup to the brewed coffee and stir to combine.
Froth the milk until hot and foamy using a Nespresso Aeroccino or steam wand.
Gently pour the frothed milk into the mug with the coffee and syrup.

preparations.roast_note: Bold, roasty profile with low acidity to punch through sweet syrups and cream.
preparations.tested_with: Medaglia d'Oro or Café Bustelo Instant Espresso
steps: In your serving mug, combine 15 ml vanilla syrup.
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 2 oz (60 ml) hot water directly in the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
